name: Monacensis Clm 4585
incipit: Incipit passio scorum martyrum Kiliani et sociorum eius
explicit: Pro cunctis sane rogita martir Kiliane / Qui contempsisti mundum pro nomine Christi / Gaudens in caelis cum quo per saecula degis / Nec non Totnanus socii simul et Colonatus
notes: Closes with a four-line leonine verse not in the other witnesses.

name: Wirceburgensis 64
incipit: In natali Scorum Martyrum Kiliani et Sociorum eius. Fuit vir vite venerabilis nomine Killena
notes: In fine mutilus. Ex libris 'Iste liber pertinet Hauch'. Emmerich: 'Aliquibus locis omittuntur, quae pertinent ad ornatum orationis' — abridges rhetorical ornament, which is why W so often shortens.

name: Pommersfeldensis 2896
notes: Lacks chapters 7 and 8; a 24-line blank follows. In cap. 9 reads 'iudicem' for 'Gozbertum occidunt gladio'. Cited by J. G. von Eckhart, Commentarii de rebus Franciae Orientalis I, f. 271.
